prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [136].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 136 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: Ask every apprentice to delay the first claim until both fares have been recorded.
options.zh: 請所有學徒等到兩程車資都登記後再送第一次申請。
options.whyZh: 上句說明可先報銷回程車資，不必等第二張收據。

options.text: Enter the outbound fare on the attendance sheet when it is known.
options.zh: 得知去程車資後，把它填到出席單上。
options.whyZh: 出席單記參與方式；去程收據要加在原報銷檔。

options.text: Use the date on each receipt to decide whether to create a new file.
options.zh: 用各張收據上的日期決定是否開新檔。
options.whyZh: 前文要求同一趟補交收據仍用同一檔；不能按收據日期分案。

options.text: Use the original journey reference on any supplemental receipt.
options.zh: 補交收據時沿用原本的差旅編號。
options.whyZh: 同一趟的兩張收據要歸入同一份報銷資料，沿用原差旅編號可讓兩張收據對應到同一趟。

explanationZh: 同一趟的兩張收據要歸入同一份報銷資料，沿用原差旅編號可讓兩張收據對應到同一趟。

vocabulary.note: supplemental 表示追加，同一趟差旅後補收據不等於另開新案。

evidence: The travel clerk can reimburse that amount now. / add it to the same reimbursement file rather than opening another one / This keeps two receipts for a single trip from being mistaken for two trips.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The travel clerk can reimburse that amount now.
add it to the same reimbursement file rather than opening another one
This keeps two receipts for a single trip from being mistaken for two trips.
